caption:
Before the meeting, in the car, or lying awake: three quiet hums, no counting.

Breathe in through your nose, then hum with your lips together until the sound fades on its own. The length of the hum sets the length of your breath out, so there's nothing to count. Hum as softly as you like. If you feel light-headed, stop and breathe normally.

Save this for the next time you need a minute.

Part two of three on humming. The hum in this Reel is Matt's own.

Research:
Bernardi, N. F., Snow, S., Peretz, I., Orozco Perez, H. D., Sabet-Kassouf, N., & Lehmann, A. (2017). Cardiorespiratory optimization during improvised singing and toning. Scientific Reports, 7, 8113. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-017-07171-2
